session_id=#{sessionId}, owner_user_id=#{ownerUserId}, requester_user_id=#{requesterUserId}, requester_unified_auth_id=#{requesterUnifiedAuthId}, requested_by_shared_user=#{requestedBySharedUser}, source_run_id=#{sourceRunId}, replacement_run_id=#{replacementRunId}, source_remote_message_id=#{sourceRemoteMessageId}, replacement_remote_message_id=#{replacementRemoteMessageId}, trigger_type=#{triggerType}, total_attempt=#{totalAttempt}, automatic_attempt=#{automaticAttempt}, automatic_limit=#{automaticLimit}, status=#{status}, execute_at=#{executeAt}, target_linux_server_id=#{targetLinuxServerId}, lease_token=#{leaseToken}, lease_until=#{leaseUntil}, client_request_id=#{clientRequestId}, trace_id=#{traceId}, safe_error_message=#{safeErrorMessage}, created_at=#{createdAt}, updated_at=#{updatedAt}
mapper.update: update run_resends set where resend_id=#{resendId} and status=#{expectedStatus}
update run_resends set where resend_id=#{resendId} and status=#{expectedStatus} and lease_token=#{expectedLeaseToken}
mapper.select: select from run_resends where owner_user_id=#{ownerUserId} and client_request_id=#{clientRequestId}
select from run_resends where session_id=#{sessionId} and status in ('WAITING','REVERTING','REVERTED') order by created_at desc limit 1

select from run_resends where (status='WAITING' and execute_at <= #{now}) or status='REVERTED' or (status='REVERTING' and lease_until <= #{now}) order by execute_at, created_at, resend_id limit #{limit}

select m.run_id as "runId", m.remote_message_id as "remoteMessageId" from session_messages m where m.session_id=#{sessionId} and m.role='USER' and m.run_id is not null and m.remote_message_id is not null and not exists ( select 1 from run_resends r where r.source_run_id=m.run_id and r.status='DISPATCHED' ) order by m.created_at desc, m.id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into run_resend_session_locks(session_id,resend_id,owner_user_id,created_at) values(#{sessionId},#{resendId},#{ownerUserId},#{now}) on conflict do nothing
mapper.delete: delete from run_resend_session_locks where session_id=#{sessionId} and resend_id=#{resendId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from run_resend_session_locks where session_id=#{sessionId}
select source_run_id from run_resends where session_id=#{sessionId} and status='DISPATCHED'
mapper.update: update ai_message_feedbacks set message_id=null where run_id=#{runId} and message_id is not null
